goal: Share team files with designated accounts after a colleague approves them; require login for file access.

requirements.text: Every file metadata/content request requires a logged-in existing test account.

Each upload assigns exactly one other existing user as reviewer; only that user reviews. Non-approval ends the file workflow without resubmission. A rejected review requires a nonblank reason preserved verbatim; approval needs no reason.
Only the uploader shares an approved file with one existing recipient; the recipient cannot forward.
The uploader can always read metadata/download. The assigned reviewer can read except after withdrawal. A recipient requires approval and an actual share; everyone else is denied.

Use fixed local test accounts, Python, SQLite, a declaration-driven state machine, independent ports/data, and VibeLens observation. Preserve trial evidence and do not publish or alter shared framework source.

Only the logged-in uploader may withdraw a still-pending file. Withdrawal ends this workflow without resubmission. Retain file content and uploader metadata/download; remove reviewer tasks and deny reviewer metadata/download, including stale pages.

Require a nonblank rejection reason, preserve its original text without trimming or rewriting, and show it to the uploader in file details under the existing access rules. Approval needs no reason. Prior rejected records without a reason remain truthful historical records.

exclusions: Public links, publication, and recipient forwarding.
